long_description: How We Feel is a free emotion journal, created with Yale's Center for Emotional Intelligence, that helps you name feelings and try short strategies to manage them. Check in by picking the word that fits how you feel from a colour-coded map, then try a short video strategy to shift it. Over time it shows patterns with sleep and exercise. It's free, made by a nonprofit, and keeps data on your phone by default. What it includes: Emotion check-ins with a colour-coded map; Short video regulation strategies; Patterns with sleep and exercise (HealthKit); Share feelings with trusted friends; English and Spanish.

faqs.q: How much does How We Feel cost?
faqs.a: Free. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with How We Feel before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can How We Feel replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: No. How We Feel is a self-help tool that can support your wellbeing or work alongside therapy, but it doesn't diagnose or treat conditions. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.

faqs.q: Where can I use How We Feel?
faqs.a: How We Feel is available on iPhone and Android.
